assign.outcome:
**A composition pass on [/imagine/screens/](/imagine/screens/)** - same eight experiments, same 24 urls, same mechanics. One new box did most of it.

![Title Slide: the cover takes the minor share, the document is placed](/framework/ai/2026-08-29/screens-comp/shots/screens-title-document-1920.png)

**The diagnosis, in one sentence.** `cqw` was reading the AREA, so a word was sized by however much screen happened to be left over rather than by the composition it belongs to - which is also why the content sat in a corner. `.screens-block` is the composition: capped at `min(100%, max(60em, 38%))`, `margin-inline: auto`, and the query container. Below ~1030px of area the cap never bites, so **Divide - the standard being measured against - is untouched**.

**Dead space became margin.** Ink to the area edge, left / right:

| | 1920 before -> after | 3440 before -> after |
|---|---|---|
| [Title Slide](/imagine/screens/title/document/), document | 56 / 967 -> **257 / 257** | 56 / 2459 -> **684 / 684** |
| [Peek](/imagine/screens/read/), document | 56 / 1156 -> 606 / 606 | 56 / 2672 -> 1322 / 1322 |
| [Deck](/imagine/screens/deck/two/), a slide | 56 / 1229 -> 480 / 805 | 56 / 2749 -> 1087 / 1608 |
| [Stack](/imagine/screens/stack/two/three/), worst band | 56 / 1722 -> 592 / 1135 | 56 / 3242 -> 1306 / 1916 |
| [Divide](/imagine/screens/divide/two/three/four/) | 24 / 98-138 -> 19 / 103-143 | 43 / 241-305 -> 34 / 237-303 |

The number that mattered was never the total, it was the **imbalance**: a slide at 3440 was 56px from the left edge and 2749px from the right.

**Type, same fix.** The 9rem ceiling was doing a composition job badly - every screen past ~1030px got the same 144px word however much room it had. Title cover **27 -> 94** at 1920 and 31 -> 151 at 3440; stack bands 72 -> 103/116, which **deleted** the special band font-size rule; deck 144 -> 177 at 3440. Divide moved 60 -> 62, and that is the padding (5% -> 4%, which also lands the 400 phone on the crumb strip), not the ramp.

**The cover takes a share, not a rail.** 14em is what made the title a heading beside 1696px of document. It is 38.2% now and the document wears `screens-major` - *Uneven's own word, reused* - so the two ARE the golden section: 733/1187 at 1920, 611/989 at 1600. Peek keeps its 14em rail on purpose: the two experiments are supposed to disagree.

**Tone: keep the step, hang it on the PAGE.** Shot both ways. Flat is prettier as a poster and says nothing; the step is what finally separates the cover from the document, which shared one sheet of paper. The hook is `.active-ancestor` on the page - **not** `.in-path`, which is `mark_links()` and lands on *anchors*: on Divide it marked three of four areas including the one you stand on.

**Seam: one device each.** A hairline divides peers; where the tone steps, the active screen paints 1px of its own paper over the column seam to its left, so the step carries the boundary alone. Divide keeps three hairlines and has none at the fourth - the rule, drawn.

![Divide at 3440: the standard held, plus you-are-here](/framework/ai/2026-08-29/screens-comp/shots/screens-divide-two-three-four-3440.png)

**Two consequences, both found by measuring rather than by reading.** The tone selector written plainly is (0,4,0) and silently beat `a.screens-area:hover` - a washed area stopped responding to the pointer while still being a link (`:where()` on the state half fixes it). And a column body is `--wash` by default, which is exactly the receded tone: the quad's menu and the quadrant it opened became the same grey and the seam between them vanished.

**Verified:** 28 urls x 400/1920/3440 = 84 cold loads, zero page errors; gestures unregressed (deck arrows step 1-2-3 and stop, ArrowLeft retreats, a click advances, Back walks backwards; the peek opens the cover and hides itself). The one 404 is core probing `readme/page.js` before the md fallback. A second 404, `/imagine/feeds/data/feeds.css`, belongs to a **sibling module outside this fence** - flagged, not touched.

**Docs:** [readme](/imagine/screens/readme/) - the block, the traps, the verdict table. The record with every before/after number is `public/imagine/screens/doc/decisions.md`.

**Deliberately not touched:** the mechanics (`full`/`fill`, the `:has()`, the basis words, `Screen.go()`, the keydown guard); Divide, Quad and Mix's arrangements; every url; Peek's 14em rail; `/imagine/feeds/`.

**Cut:** a `container-type: size` band (a box with it stops being sized by its own contents); aligning the block to the crumb strip at every width (the strip is a fixed inset, a screen's padding is a share); a shadow at the seam (rule 4 is one device); making Peek golden too (it would have deleted the finding).

**Shots:** 27 keepers at 400/1920/3440 in `shots/`, named to pair with the originals in `screens-lab/shots/`.
